title: chat-filenode: rights gaps in role table
description: Pre-existing, found by ak09 review: (1) manage_channels has mayDelete on the tree root but creating the root needs manage_space; (2) no role gets mayModifyContent on the root; (3) mayShare meaning undefined since non-members SHOULD NOT get access whatever the ACL says; (4) under filenode -17 an onExists overwrite needs mayDelete, so a send member cannot overwrite even their own uploads.
close_reason: Root delete needs manage_space; inapplicable flags false; no mayShare (shareWith rejected on Space trees); no per-uploader rights documented.
